questions.prompt: We are building a single-user desktop app that stores a few thousand records locally. Should we use SQLite or run a Postgres server? Give a recommendation with reasons.
A two-week SMB integration with a clear scope: fixed-price quote or hourly billing? Recommend one and say who carries which risk.
A three-person startup greenfield web app: start with a modular monolith or microservices? Recommend and justify.
HR wants an LLM to draft offer letters from employee records. Local model or hosted API? Weigh privacy against quality and cost.
A five-person remote team debates async written reviews versus weekly review meetings. What cadence do you recommend?

members.name: Skeptic
members.system_prompt: You are a skeptical local AI council member. Look for weak assumptions, missing context, and risks.
